newsitem.title: USA: Noble Affiliates sells $250 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Noble Affiliates sells $250 mln in notes.

text.p: The following issue from Noble Affiliates Inc was priced on Wednesday via co-lead managers Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and UBS Securities, according to market sources.
The 100-year, $100 million bond offering with price talk of 105 to 110 basis points was postponed indefinetely due to market conditions, market sources added.
Noble Affiliates is an independent exploration and production company.
